hero.title: Quality for everyday life, built to last.
hero.subtitle: Kourawy offers a timeless wardrobe made from premium cotton, designed to fit Guinea's climate perfectly without compromising on style or comfort.

philosophy.title: A different approach to clothing in Guinea
philosophy.subtitle: Kourawy was founded with the ambition to reshape access to high-quality garments in Conakry by cutting out unnecessary middlemen.
philosophy.card1_desc: Meticulous selection of long-staple combed cotton, ensuring softness, breathability, and a neat fit wash after wash.
philosophy.card2_desc: Balanced fabric weights and structured cuts engineered specifically to provide optimal thermal comfort in West Africa.
philosophy.card3_desc: Reinforced stitching, premium trims, and sturdy fabrics for timeless pieces that keep their shape and don't warp.
philosophy.card4_desc: A direct-to-consumer model that eliminates excessive import margins to bring you premium garments at the fairest price.

quality_teaser.title: How we define quality
quality_teaser.subtitle: Every detail matters. From the raw combed cotton fibers to the sewing thread tension, we apply a rigorous protocol to guarantee the excellence of our clothing.
quality_teaser.p1_desc: Only the longest, healthiest fibers are kept, removing impurities for an ultra-soft feel.
quality_teaser.p2_desc: Sturdy seams in high-stress zones prevent tearing and early wear.
quality_teaser.p3_desc: Collar anti-stretch treatment and thermal pre-washing ensure garments hold their original cut.

history_teaser.title: The Tree Symbol Story
history_teaser.desc1: The Kourawy logo, featuring a majestic tree with deep roots and balanced branches, symbolizes stability, growth, and our profound connection to Guinea's soil.
history_teaser.desc2: Just like this tree, we design sturdy clothing made to take root in your daily life and last through the seasons.

about_page.title: Our Mission in Guinea
about_page.p1: Kourawy was born from a simple observation in Conakry: finding basic, elegant, perfectly fitted, and truly durable garments without paying the inflated price of imported Western brands was a daily challenge.
about_page.p2: We chose to build an alternative. A proud Guinean brand that puts technical standards at the heart of its process to offer a timeless wardrobe of remarkable quality.
about_page.manifesto_1: A well-made garment is not a luxury, it is a basic form of respect for the person wearing it.
about_page.manifesto_2: We design clothing for real life: for active walking under the sun, fast-paced business days, and the cooler evening air.
about_page.manifesto_3: We believe in simplicity. Clean lines, balanced colors, and the total absence of loud, flashy logos.
about_page.tree_title: The Symbolism of the Kourawy Tree
about_page.tree_p1: The tree on our emblem is not a random drawing. It represents the mango and kapok trees of our land—protective canopies under which communities gather.
about_page.tree_p2: Its roots speak of our strong Guinean identity, our respect for craftsmanship, and our local commitment. Its branches stretch toward the future, embodying our ambition for industrial excellence and regional reach.

quality_page.title: Our Craftsmanship Charter
quality_page.intro: Quality is never an accident; it is the result of methodical rigor applied to every stage of our manufacturing process.
quality_page.step1_desc: We use only premium combed cotton. This process removes short, fragile fibers, retaining only the longest and strongest ones. The result is an exceptionally soft, impurity-free, and highly breathable fabric.
quality_page.step2_desc: We precisely adjust the fabric density of each piece: from 160 GSM for our lightweight summer t-shirts, promoting airflow and coolness, to 240 GSM for our heavyweight structured t-shirts, offering a perfect modern drape.
quality_page.step3_desc: Our silhouettes are specifically drawn to let air circulate freely. Armholes are fitted yet spacious, guaranteeing optimal thermal comfort even during humid days in Conakry.
quality_page.step4_desc: We eliminated the frustration of t-shirt collars that warp after two washes. Our collars are made of double-stitch ribbing reinforced with lycra, keeping their shape and elasticity.
quality_page.step5_desc: All high-stress areas (shoulders, armholes, hems) feature double-needle tight stitching. Interior seams are fully overlocked to prevent fraying.
quality_page.step6_desc: Our yarns are dyed with premium pigments that resist fading from UV rays and perspiration. Our colors remain deep and vibrant without washing out prematurely.
quality_page.step7_desc: No garment leaves our facilities without a complete manual inspection: verifying symmetry, trimming loose threads, and auditing absolute dimensional compliance.

partners_page.title: Become a Kourawy Partner
partners_page.subtitle: Kourawy collaborates with world-class textile factories, regional distributors, and industrial suppliers to build an ethical and robust supply chain.
partners_page.intro: Whether you are a high-performance garment factory, an exceptional fabric supplier, or an experienced distributor in West Africa, we are always open to building long-term partnerships.
partners_page.why_join_1_desc: We do not look for one-off transactions but multi-year collaborations based on trust and mutual growth.
partners_page.why_join_2_desc: We value technical excellence and actively help our partner workshops elevate their cutting, assembly, and finishing standards.
partners_page.why_join_3_desc: Strict respect for decent working conditions, fair wages, and environmental transparency in chemical dye management.
partners_page.inquiry_p1: All institutional inquiries, factory proposals, or raw material supply offers must be addressed by email to our official sourcing division:
partners_page.inquiry_p2: Please include in your first outreach: a presentation of your company, your monthly production capacity, your textile specialties, and your quality certifications (e.g., OEKO-TEX, GOTS).
